value.summary: The change adapts the host loop from processing one authorized turn per step to processing a round of concurrent turns, committing the shared `next_state` once after every turn is durably appended. The pinboard read is correctly bounded by `turn.round_start` to prevent leaking concurrently-written pins, the failure path appends a system row and continues without committing mid-round, and the round-length budget advance matches the old per-turn accounting. No bugs introduced.
